# Tej R Portfolio

Web Developer specializing in React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and modern frontend development.

## Skills
- React, Next.js (App Router), TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS, SASS/SCSS, Bootstrap
- WordPress (Headless, ACF, WPGraphQL)
- Node.js, Express, PHP, SQL
- Git/GitHub, Figma, CI/CD (Vercel, Netlify, GitHub Actions)
- Responsive Design, Accessibility, Performance Optimization
